summary.name: San Francisco Reliability Engineering
summary.one_liner: A Meetup group in San Francisco for people interested in reliable, performant software systems, holding monthly meetings (mostly online talks in 2021).
use_cases: find monthly reliability engineering talks in San Francisco
meet other SRE and reliability engineers
learn what goes into keeping software systems reliable
attend online talks on performance and operations
summary.what_it_does: The page is the Meetup group page for San Francisco Reliability Engineering, a group of people interested in reliable, performant software systems. It describes itself as hosting a monthly meeting open to professional reliability engineers, newcomers, and the simply curious. The page lists 55 past events, with the most recent visible ones being online "Talks" sessions from June to November 2021, each with roughly 30 to 60 attendees. The group has 2,313 members and a 4.7 rating from 249 ratings, and is tagged with related topics such as open source, system administration, cloud computing, and application performance monitoring.
notable: Monthly meetings with talks, held online in 2021 listings
2,313 members and a 4.7 rating from 249 ratings
Listed in the awesome-sre list under Conferences & Meetups
caveats: Most visible events are from 2021, so current meeting schedule is not confirmed by the page
Membership fees for the Meetup group are not stated on the page
